products.description: The Kiko Kostadinov x ASICS LYASA FF II, the final release in the four-part series of the tabi silhouette introduced earlier this year. Designed by Laura and Deanna Fanning, the ASICS LYASA FF II debuted on the Autumn Winter 2026 Kiko Kostadinov Womenswear runway. The shoe merges the language of a brogue at the front with the structure of a trail shoe at the back, bringing together the refinement of traditional leather footwear with the technical character of outdoor footwear. The release is accompanied by Ghost Tracks , the final episode of American artist Ryan Trecartin’s episodic campaign titled BUCKLE YUP . Released throughout 2026 alongside each new tabi runner by Kiko Kostadinov and ASICS, the series comprises three acts followed by this fourth and final campaign, which serves as its epilogue. The Kiko Kostadinov x ASICS LYASA FF II is available in Clay Grey / Jasper Green or Reddish Brown / ASICS Blue. Sizing guidance: This style runs true to size. However, we recommend sizing up by half a size for a more comfortable fit due to the split-toe design.
